tenantTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER audit_tenant_status_security AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.tenants FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.status IS DISTINCT FROM old.status)) EXECUTE FUNCTION safebus_private.capture_sensitive_admin_audit()

CREATE TRIGGER enforce_tenant_status_security BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON public.tenants FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.status IS DISTINCT FROM old.status)) EXECUTE FUNCTION safebus_private.enforce_sensitive_admin_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER set_updated_at_tenants BEFORE UPDATE ON public.tenants FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION safebus_private.set_updated_at()
CREATE TRIGGER tenants_create_guardian_notification_policy AFTER INSERT ON public.tenants FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION safebus_private.create_default_guardian_notification_policy()
